market_question: Iran closes its airspace by June 30?
reasoning: Iran has closed its airspace twice in 2024 (April and October) during military escalations with Israel. With tensions ongoing and no clear path to de-escalation, another major closure within 1.5 years is more likely than the market implies. The resolution criteria are broad and include short-lived closures, making the event plausible.
evidence_points: Iran closed its western airspace in April 2024 and entire airspace briefly in October 2024, both qualifying.
Israel-Iran proxy conflict and direct exchanges remain active, with periodic retaliation loops.
No diplomatic breakthroughs suggest risk of future closures is sustained at elevated levels.
sources_consulted: Reuters reports on April 2024 and October 2024 Iran airspace closures
